title: The Nazirite Vow and the Rules for Consecration
description:
The Lord gives Moses instructions on how a man or woman may make a Nazirite vow to set themselves apart for the Lord.  
Whoever takes the vow must stay away from wine and everything that comes from the grapevine, not shave their hair, and not go near a dead body—not even close relatives.  

If someone dies suddenly beside them, their consecration becomes unclean, and they must undergo cleansing with a sin offering, a burnt offering, and a guilt offering before starting the vow again.  
When the time of consecration is completed, the Nazirite shall bring a burnt offering, a sin offering, and a peace offering to the tent of meeting, shave off their consecrated hair, and place it on the fire beneath the peace offering.  

After the priest has waved the offerings before the Lord, the Nazirite may drink wine again.
